svg.title: Lambda dynamic provisioned concurrency
svg.desc: Clients call a Lambda alias through its Function URL; CloudWatch target tracking alarms on ProvisionedConcurrencyUtilization drive Application Auto Scaling, which sets the alias provisioned concurrency.
